title: Mega Man ZX
collection: Mega Man Zero/ZX Legacy Collection · DS
intro: Find your way through the connected map, recover both halves of each Biometal and collect every health upgrade, Sub Tank and equipment chip.
libraryIntro: Connected-area directions, four health upgrades, four tanks and Biometal repair.
primer: ZX connects its stages into one world. Accept a mission at a Transerver before setting out, and report it after the boss. Area letters are destinations; the map layout does not show literal screen positions. Use the connections map below when a doorway is unclear.

Choose Vent or Aile at the start. The main route is shared, but dialogue and a few optional quests differ. Human form can crouch through low passages and talk to civilians. Merge again before combat: the human form cannot fight effectively.

Model ZX combines Saber and Buster. HX adds air dashes, FX breaks blocks, LX swims and PX reveals dark passages. Each paired form needs two bosses for its full energy and charged attacks. Fire beats Ice, Ice beats Thunder, Thunder beats Fire.

Sub Tanks and Life Ups make a first run much more forgiving. Equip Item B chips in the menu after obtaining them; they are not automatically active. Save often at Transervers: running out of lives normally returns you to your last save. Save Assist adds optional collection checkpoints.
features: Hitting a boss’s weak point lowers the recovered Biometal’s level and available weapon energy. HX reveals those points. Avoid them for Level 4 recovery, or pay Fleuve to repair a damaged form later. A low recovery level does not ruin the save.

For the ending, take the eight bosses in this order and collect health and tanks as their requirements become available. For completion, add chips, NPC quests, Level 4 recoveries, disks and the optional OX detour.

warning.title: Model OX is a postgame reward on Normal or Hard.
warning.text: Easy mode does not award the Mysterious Rock. You can finish the main story without OX. Defeat the optional boss and collect the rock, then use a cleared save to have Fleuve make the form.

routeIntro: HX first provides mobility and an early tank. Complete its second half, then use its electricity against the fire bosses. This route favors reliable exploration over Level 4 recovery challenges.
route: Opening: Locate Giro from the B-2 Transerver, up the ladder and right. For Pass the Test, find the Guardians in order from left to right, then return to the real B-2 Transerver.
Clear Mavericks Detected in D, then follow the eight Pseudoroids below. Complete the automatic Guardian HQ attack when prompted.
Stop the Dig: enter M from A-4. Repel the Army: enter O from D-3. Collect the remaining upgrades before accepting Destroy Model W.

stages.name: Mavericks Detected
stages.area: Area D · from the opening missions
stages.tip: Clear the highway mission, then report at the Transerver. ZX supplies the familiar Saber and Buster.

items.name: Life Up · D-1
items.text: Look through the shallow highway gap for a red switch above a locked door. Shoot the switch and enter; the health upgrade is inside.
items.extra: Each Life Up adds four maximum health.
items.when: First visit, or return if missed

stages.name: Hivolt
stages.area: Search the Plant · E · enter from C-2
stages.weakness: Ice later; neutral charged attacks first
stages.tip: Keep clear of his wings and attack between passes. HX gives air dashes and a hover, making exploration much easier.
stages.now: Sub Tank · E-4 · Sub Tank · A-2

items.name: Sub Tank · E-4
items.text: Take the lower branch in the giant-gear room. From the highest conveyor step, dash-jump to the upper-right ledge and defeat its guard.
items.extra: Turning off the electricity makes the approach safer.
items.when: First visit, or return if missed

items.name: Sub Tank · A-2
items.text: Above the A-1 entrance, reach the ledge beneath the visible tank. Climb the left wall and continue through the false ceiling. HX helps reach the ledge.
items.extra: A tank stores surplus health pickups while your health is full.
items.when: Return after unlocking the listed form

stages.name: Hurricaune
stages.area: Save the People · I · from E-7
stages.tip: Avoid her lightning and recover both HX halves. Fully charged HX now creates a tornado.

items.name: Life Up · I-5
items.text: Choose the upper route at the split. After the miniboss, lift the unpowered platform with charged HX tornadoes. Ride upward, then air-dash and hover right past the spikes.
items.extra: Collect after the boss, or on a later return.
items.when: Return after unlocking the listed form

items.name: Absorber Chip
items.text: After rescuing the civilians and reporting the mission, repeatedly talk to Leonardo in the C-2 house beside the fountain.
items.extra: Activate in Item B to prevent knockback.
items.when: Return after unlocking the listed form

stages.name: Fistleo
stages.area: Fight the Mavericks · G · from D-3
stages.tip: Use HX electricity for a straightforward win. If aiming for Level 4 recovery, avoid hitting his head and use attacks that do not strike the weak point.

items.name: Frog Chip
items.text: Accept Karen’s Find the Boy quest in C-1. In Area G, find every child playing hide-and-seek, including the one outside left. Report, then speak to Kenny in C-1 while transformed.
items.when: Return after unlocking the listed form

stages.name: Lurerre
stages.area: Find the Survivors · F · from upper B-3
stages.tip: Use FX fire against her main body. LX swims freely and reveals nearby objects on the lower screen.

items.name: Life Up · F-2
items.text: Break the ice blocks with FX and follow the upper-left passage. At the shallow row of spikes, use HX upward dash and hover left to reach the upgrade.
items.extra: Keep clear of enemies that could knock you onto the spikes.
items.when: First visit, or return if missed

stages.name: Purprill
stages.area: Secure the Biometal · H · from A-3
stages.tip: Attack after his swings and keep away from falling debris. Complete the Guardian HQ attack when the story interrupts this route.

items.name: Eraser Chip
items.text: In Guardian HQ, use Talk with Carrelet until he offers the chip.
items.extra: Saber attacks can destroy small energy shots.
items.when: First visit, or return if missed

items.name: Featherweight Chip
items.text: After the HQ attack and Prometheus battle, repeatedly talk to Bar in the HQ corridor.
items.extra: Prevents fragile floors from crumbling beneath you.
items.when: First visit, or return if missed

stages.name: Protectos
stages.area: Protect the Lab · L · from H-4
stages.tip: Move away from the missiles before striking. Full PX improves its charge options and is useful for dark passages.

items.name: Sub Tank · Guardian HQ
items.text: Talk to nurse Muguet for Deliver the Aid Kit, then Rose for Deliver the Energy Pack. Find each requested item in Area L supply crates and report. Alternate the two quests three times each, then speak to the requestor for the tank.
items.extra: If a quest is unavailable, advance the story and ask again.
items.when: Return after unlocking the listed form

stages.name: Flammole
stages.area: Attack the Excavators · K · from C-3
stages.tip: Use HX electricity; keep an escape path clear when lava rises.
stages.now: Sub Tank · K-1 · Wind Boots Chip · Extender Chip

items.name: Sub Tank · K-1
items.text: Set the K-1 lava controller to Slow. On the underground route toward K-4, break the high brown blocks with FX before the lava arrives. Use PX to find the concealed doorway to the right and press its red switch. Return through the rising-lava shaft to K-1; enter the red door above the cable car and swim left with LX.
items.extra: Collect on a cleared-stage return so backtracking is available. Lava and spikes remain lethal on Normal.
items.when: Return after unlocking the listed form

items.name: Wind Boots Chip
items.text: Ask Anguille at HQ for Gather the Screws. Search K-4 behind the breakable blocks and nearby lava gap, K-3’s rightmost lava gap, and both sides of K-5’s rising-lava shaft. Report all five screws.
items.extra: One screw lies in lava: take an enemy hit immediately before entering, collect it during the flashing grace period and leave. This is the quest’s hazard route; do not enter at full vulnerability.
items.when: Return after unlocking the listed form

items.name: Extender Chip
items.text: Ask Silure at HQ for Obtain the Rock, collect it in K, and report. Accept Smash the Rock next. Find Oeillet in E-4 with the conveyor powered; collect the crushed pieces and report.
items.need: Full Model FX · both quests accepted
items.extra: Extends protection after taking a hit.
items.when: Return after unlocking the listed form

stages.name: Leganchor
stages.area: Recover the Disk · J · from A-4
stages.tip: Use FX at an opening; LX is better for navigating the underwater stage.
stages.now: Life Up · J-1 · Quick Charger Chip · Ice Boots Chip · Vent · Ice Boots Chip · Aile

items.name: Life Up · J-1
items.text: From the Transerver, descend into the underwater passage. Look for the background doorway left of the first underwater enemy. Inside, swim right over the spikes to the health upgrade.
items.extra: Enemy hits cancel swimming; clear the path before crossing.
items.when: First visit, or return if missed

items.name: Quick Charger Chip
items.text: Once all four paired forms are complete, repeatedly choose Talk with Fleuve at Guardian HQ.
items.need: Full HX, FX, LX and PX
items.when: First visit, or return if missed

items.name: Ice Boots Chip · Vent
items.text: Complete Yu’s two quiz quests in C-1 and report each at a Transerver. Give the Pink Crystal reward to Jack by the green door in C-1.
items.extra: Stops slipping on ice floors, but not ice walls.
items.when: Return after unlocking the listed form

items.name: Ice Boots Chip · Aile
items.text: Ask Arcea in C-2 for Find Mushroom. Bring the mushroom from A-2, then accept the follow-up: Mushroom is her bird. Touch the small bird as it flies away in A-2 and return it.
items.extra: An alternative to Vent’s quiz chain, not a second chip.
items.when: Return after unlocking the listed form

returnIntro: Once all forms are complete, revisit A, I and K and finish the HQ tank quest. Open a level below to see its items together. Only the chip path for your chosen character is needed.
completionText: Normal: four Life Ups, four Sub Tanks, all paired Biometals. Optional: eight Item B chip types, Level 4 recoveries, all disks and quests. Ice Boots has two character-specific paths to the same item.

sections.title: Destroy Model W
paragraphs: Enter the mission’s HQ route from Area D. In each elevator computer room, stand on a glowing corner crystal and press Up to enter a rematch. The pairs are Hivolt/Hurricaune, Lurerre/Leganchor, Fistleo/Flammole, Purprill/Protectos.

Use the enemy-filled corridors between elevators to restore weapon energy and fill tanks before the last battles. Use charged attacks against Serpent; the large final form can be hit at the head or forehead gem depending on its height. HX tornadoes are useful when it rises.

A loss during the last pair requires both fights again. Preserve tanks while learning the first fight; use them when a clear is within reach. Save the offered clear data to retain access to the world.

sections.title: Optional · Model OX
paragraphs: After Stop the Dig, enter N from the Transerver end of M. Cross the disappearing-block spike passages and defeat Omega. Return to the main shaft, drop to its lowest route and go right past the Link Mode boss doors. Take the Mysterious Rock in the final room.

Finish the main game on Normal or Hard, load the clear save, and choose Talk with Fleuve until he takes the rock. Model OX has powerful Overdrive attacks; it is a bonus form, not a cosmetic recolor or a requirement for the ending.

The collection’s Link Mode recreates the Zero 3/4 cartridge bosses. Defeating both sets of four is an alternative rock unlock; Omega needs no link setting. Keep a save before the optional spike route.

sections.title: Useful tips
paragraphs: Transervers restore health and can replenish a low life stock. Collect surplus health outside a mission to fill tanks, then save.
NPC chips often need story progress and repeated Talk selections. If a character repeats the same line, finish another main mission and check again.
Rematch bosses for improved Biometal recovery if you prefer that to paying repair costs. Level 4 dolls and alternate character clears are optional completion goals.
